title: Hinomori Shizuku — Cooking To Give You Energy♪〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Marathon Course

rows.Speaker: Locals
rows.Line:
This is the last poster.
Can you stick it on this column for me?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Yes, of course.
How does this look?

rows.Speaker: Locals
rows.Line:
Ah, that's perfect!
You being able to reach up so high has made this much easier.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm glad that I'm able to put my height to such good use.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Okay, it needs to be a little above head height so that it can be seen from afar...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
No, my tape!
Oh, dear...

rows.Speaker: Locals
rows.Line:
Oh, it rolled away.
I'll go get it, so use my tape instead!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Th-Thank you very much...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
The last poster is up.
Thank you for letting me borrow your tape.

rows.Speaker: Locals
rows.Line:
Don't worry about that.
You helping us was absolutely enormous.
Anyway, let's start heading back, shall we?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Okay...
Let's see... This way to town hall, right?
se_walk_women_003_1

rows.Speaker: Locals
rows.Line:
Hm...?
No, Shizuku, stop! That'll take you to the other side of town!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Huh? Oh no! I'm so sorry...

rows.Speaker: Locals
rows.Line: We didn't realize you were so bad with directions. We can't take our eyes off you for a second.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Airi's always telling me the same thing.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Oh, I went and did it again.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (I want to be more helpful tomorrow, but what can I do?)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Oh, I know!)
The next day

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Phew...
We've finished picking up all the trash along the course.

rows.Speaker: Locals
rows.Line:
Yes. Thank you for your help, Shizuku.
Why don't we all take our break now?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Excuse me, everyone!
I actually made a little something for all of you today...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
I prepared some soup using wild herbs.
I have it here in my thermos. Would anybody like some?

rows.Speaker: Locals
rows.Line:
Huh...?
Wild herb soup in a thermos?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes. It's very healthy and should help warm you right up. I thought it'd be nice to have during our break.

rows.Speaker: Locals
rows.Line: So, that's really nice of you, but why soup?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Last week, Mrs. Fujita taught me how to make it, and it was so delicious!

rows.Speaker: Locals
rows.Line: Oh, she taught you?!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes. When I asked her about local delicacies we could pass out during the marathon, she suggested that we try making this together.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
The vegetables seem soft enough.
I'll put in the wild herbs and fried tofu now!

rows.Speaker: Elderly Lady
rows.Line:
Alright, keep moving! Chop chop!
Everything's prepped, so start putting it in the pot.

rows.Speaker: Elderly Lady
rows.Line: Oh, but that doesn't mean you should just dump it in all at once. You don't want it to splash and hurt someone.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Okay!
So, like this?

rows.Speaker: Elderly Lady
rows.Line: Mm. That should do just fine.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Thank goodness...
And thank you!

rows.Speaker: Elderly Lady
rows.Line:
Hey, who said you could stop?!
We're not going to finish until morning if you keep taking breaks like that. Again, chop chop!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: R-Right!

rows.Speaker: Elderly Lady
rows.Line:
Hmm...
Yes, it seems to be coming along nicely.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I couldn't have done this without you, Mrs. Fujita. Thank you very much for all your help!

rows.Speaker: Elderly Lady
rows.Line: Yes...

rows.Speaker: Elderly Lady
rows.Line: You know, Shizuku, us cooking together like this reminds me of when I used to do this with my grandchildren.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: It does? Hehe. It's sweet of you to say that. I feel like I have another grandmother now.

rows.Speaker: Elderly Lady
rows.Line: No, I really don't think you'd want a curmudgeon like me in your family. I doubt you'd even want to cook with me.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
No, that's not true.
I think it's normal for people to talk passionately about the things they love doing.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, I'll turn the stove off and start mixing in the miso.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Let's see... The miso should be in... This container! Three tablespoons and...

rows.Speaker: Elderly Lady
rows.Line:
No, Shizuku, wait!
That's not miso! It's red bean paste!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: What?!

rows.Speaker: Elderly Lady
rows.Line:
Phew... That was close.
The miso should be in the container with the yellow lid.

rows.Speaker: Elderly Lady
rows.Line:
Ah, delicious!
Well done, Shizuku.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
...!
Thank you very much!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: So, I decided to make some more using Mrs. Fujita's recipe.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: This soup's supposed to give this town a boost of energy, so I thought it would help you all...

rows.Speaker: Locals
rows.Line: Shizuku...

rows.Speaker: Locals
rows.Line: You've already cheered us up plenty!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But you've all been helping me so much...

rows.Speaker: Locals
rows.Line: Nonsense! We know you're doing your absolute best. If anything, that clumsy side of you is very endearing.

rows.Speaker: Locals
rows.Line:
I agree.
You even made soup for us. Of course we're grateful.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Everyone...

rows.Speaker: Locals
rows.Line: Mind pouring me a bowl?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Of course!
Let me get everything ready.

rows.Speaker: Locals
rows.Line: Alright, soup's up.

rows.Speaker: Locals
rows.Line:
Mmm! This is amazing!
I can see why Mrs. Fujita gave you her seal of approval. She can be pretty ruthless when it comes to cooking!

rows.Speaker: Locals
rows.Line:
This miso really hits the spot.
I'm ready to get right back to work for the afternoon!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Hehe. I'm glad to hear that!
There's still plenty, so please feel free to ask for seconds!

rows.Speaker: Locals
rows.Line: In that case, I'll have another!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Okay!
